title: Reverse-step transformation is polynomial-time computable
statement: For a bit string $S$, return $S$ if its first decoded component is empty. Otherwise, return the paired encoding of the tail of that component and a second component formed by prefixing its first bit to the second decoded component of $S$; failed pair decodings yield empty components, and the first bit of an empty list is taken to be $0$. This function is polynomial-time computable.
